programs.name: Computer Science BCompSc
programs.a_level_offer: GCE A/AS Levels: aggregate 10 from the best 3 (or 2) A Level subjects (A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1; AS Levels count half); minimum grade D at A level. Prerequisites: A/AS Level Mathematics (or GCSE/O level Maths plus Additional Maths) and an English subject at GCSE/O level or A/AS Level.
programs.ib_offer: IB Diploma total 32 (completed Diploma; grade 3 in HL subjects, 4 in SL subjects). Prerequisites: English (English B, English A Literature or English A Language & Literature, SL or HL) and Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches SL/HL, or Applications and Interpretations SL/HL).
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma plus College Board AP: AP aggregate 13 (minimum 2, maximum 4 AP exams, best 4 used; A=5, B=4, C=3 (Pass), D=2, E=1; AP minimum grade 3; English (AP) listed as the English prerequisite; AP grades on the school transcript alone do not count). Or SAT-I 1170 (taken since March 2016; 1730 for tests 2005 to Jan 2016) or ACT composite 26, with evidence of a recognised school leaving certificate. No separate AP maths prerequisite is listed for this program.
programs.required_subjects: English (General English, Units 3 & 4, C) and Mathematical Methods (Units 3 & 4, C) or equivalent; Specialist Mathematics recommended
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT (including Paper Edition): overall 87, listening 19, reading 19, writing 21, speaking 19 (old 0-120 scale). The page gives no score on the new 1-6 scale.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with 6 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. Also accepted per the page: PTE Academic overall 64 with 60 in all sub-bands; Cambridge (CES) overall 176 and 169 in all sub-bands; BE overall grade 4 and C in all macro skills. OET is not accepted.
programs.notes: 2027 entry (Semester 1 starts 22 Feb 2027). 'atar' is the lowest adjusted ATAR/Rank UQ made an offer to in Semester 1 2026 (UQ updates these guide scores each April; meeting it does not guarantee admission). The international score table (A-level, IB, AP, SAT, ACT) is the page's own 'minimum entry score' widget for a student who studied in the United States, loaded from https://study.uq.edu.au/api/program-requirements/2559-2027?year=2027&country=United%20States&term=7720 ; the same A-level and IB scores appear for England. Fee is the page's 'Approximate yearly cost of tuition (16 units)' for international students, 2027 (AUD). Applications direct to UQ (or via a UQ agent) for Semester 1 close 30 November of the previous year, i.e. 30 Nov 2026; students whose senior schooling is Australian Year 12 or IB in Australia apply via QTAC instead. The domestic table on the same page shows ATAR 84 / IB 32. Accredited by the Australian Computer Society. Majors: Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Data Science, Programming Theory. CRICOS 096359G.

programs.name: Engineering (Honours) BEng(Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: GCE A/AS Levels: aggregate 10.5 from the best 3 (or 2) A Level subjects (A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1; AS Levels count half); minimum grade D at A level. Prerequisites: A/AS Level Mathematics (or GCSE/O level Maths plus Additional Maths) and A/AS Level Chemistry or Physics (or AS Physical Science), and an English subject at GCSE/O level or A/AS Level.
programs.ib_offer: IB Diploma total 32.75 on UQ's table (IB totals are whole numbers, so 33 is the lowest total that meets it); completed Diploma, grade 3 in HL subjects and 4 in SL. Prerequisites: English (as for Computer Science), Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches SL/HL, or Applications and Interpretations SL/HL) and Chemistry (HL or SL) or Physics (HL or SL; Physical Science HL and Physical Chemical Systems HL also listed).
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma plus College Board AP: AP aggregate 14 (minimum 2, maximum 4 AP exams, best 4 used; A=5, B=4, C=3 (Pass), D=2, E=1; AP minimum grade 3) with English (AP) and Chemistry (AP) or Physics (AP). Or SAT-I 1190 (taken since March 2016; 1760 for tests 2005 to Jan 2016) or ACT composite 27, with evidence of a recognised school leaving certificate (the SAT/ACT rows list Chemistry and Physics as the subject prerequisite).
programs.required_subjects: English (General English, Units 3 & 4, C), Mathematical Methods (Units 3 & 4, C) and one of Chemistry or Physics (Units 3 & 4, C); Specialist Mathematics and both Chemistry and Physics recommended
